description: Courant Flowmap elevates geographic data visualization in Power BI by beautifully rendering the movement of objects, people, or data between locations. Built on the Open Street Maps and powered by D3.js, this visual goes far beyond basic line-drawing to deliver a fully interactive and analytical mapping experience. Key Capabilities & Value Delivered: Intelligent Geocoding & Mapping: Input exact Latitude/Longitude coordinates for high performance. Data-Driven Flow Lines: Visualize route volume, weight, or frequency through dynamic line thickness. Apply Linear or Logarithmic scaling algorithms to handle massive data variations and extreme outliers gracefully. Advanced Color Coding: Style your routes using automatic categorical color assignment, numeric metric gradient scales between endpoints, or dynamically inject explicit CSS color code fields directly from your source data. Aggregated Endpoint Analytics: When multiple distinct flows converge at a single destination, Courant intelligently aggregates the underlying fields and renders customizable, segmented interactive Pie Chart markers directly on the map. Seamless Power BI Interactivity: Full integration with Power BI selection features.
